projectDescription: RollingGo Partner Center is a self-service onboarding portal that lets enterprises, developers, KOL affiliates, and individual users instantly access travel MCP products, APIs, and distribution tools.
keyFeatures: Instant partner onboarding with zero review wait time — submit and receive credentials immediately
Four partner types: Enterprise, Developer, KOL Affiliate, and Personal
Enterprise and Developer partners receive an API Key and account password via email on submission
KOL Affiliates receive a unique H5 distribution link instantly upon submission
Personal users get MCP/Skill configuration bundles and install commands without creating an account
Global region binding: China Mainland (rollinggo.cn / CNY) and International (rollinggo.ai / USD)
Email verification with 6-digit OTP at registration
publicApiSurface: API Key (issued to Enterprise and Developer partners)
MCP connection parameters (issued to Enterprise partners)
H5 affiliate distribution link (issued to KOL partners)
Personal configuration package / install commands (issued to Personal users)
OAuth dynamic authentication for Personal users
